'NAPAKAPAYAPA NG GINAWANG PAGKILOS NG MGA NAGPO-PROTESTA'

Inanunsyo ni Department of Interior and Local Government (DILG) na naging mapayapa at walang nasaktan sa naganap na anti-corruption protest nitong Linggo, November 30.

Ayon sa  kalihim ay nasunod ang naging paghahanda ng Philippine National Police (PNP) at sumunod rin ang mga lumahok sa protesta.

Tinatayang hindi lalagpas sa 20,000 katao umano sa buong Metro Manila ang lumahok sa protesta.

IN PHOTOS | Crowds of various groups and individuals gather at the People Power Monument for the “Trillion Pesos March” protest against corruption, as Miss Universe 2018 Catriona Gray also attended to express her solidarity with Filipinos participating in the nationwide demonstrations on Sunday (November 30.  

She also asserted that the youth will not allow corruption to persist and rejected claims that Filipinos easily forget political wrongdoing, declaring, “We will not forget what you did at walang magmo move on hangga’t walang nananagot!".

📷 Edd Castro

For more info, visit https://t.co/rmQCnNSOvI.
